div.font:
mcda_add_score() in metrics-fun.R
Input: dist cols + weights + norm_scope
Output: mcda_score
Two uses:
A) Standalone global ranking (norm_scope=global)
B) Internal ranking inside selector (norm_scope=filtered)

div.font:
05-9_decisions_selector_settings.R
For each setting:
1) filter_expr (hard constraints)
2) target_col + n_per_target (coverage)
3) ranking:
• rank_mode=lex (rank_cols) OR
• rank_mode=mcda (mcda_score)
4) d_min_m (spacing via thinning)
5) point-on-surface for candidate points
Outputs: per-setting segments + points (tmp gpkg)

div.div:
S6 validation (evaluation of candidate sets)
Check:
• coverage completeness (targets filled?)
• spatial spacing achieved?
• overlap vs MCDA baseline
• representativeness metrics per domain
• scenario comparisons
